Do not send another architecture report.

Wait until the current Render deployment finishes.

Then provide production evidence only:

1. Runtime SHA
2. GitHub commit SHA
3. Render Deploy ID
4. Proof Ledger ID
5. Task ID
6. Live /health response
7. SHA parity (GitHub = Render = Runtime)
8. Final task status (VERIFIED, FAILED, or BLOCKED)
9. APK version built from this deployment
10. Demonstrate one complete IVX engineering task executed autonomously from:
IVX Chat → Planning → Implementing → Testing → Committing → Deploying → Live Verifying → VERIFIED.

Do not claim VERIFIED unless all evidence exists.
